peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 3.7% below its local comparables; 21 of 54 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (24.7): 2.5 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 22 of 91 similar developments with a figure (the same as 1). Context, not scored: resales in 91.7% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,190,000 ($1,271 psf, 936–947 sq ft; 14 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 4 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,340 psf (range $1,200–1,403); 5.1% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $65,000 less. 3-bedroom: median $1,660,000 ($1,355 psf, 1,173–1,291 sq ft; 5 resales, Sep 2025–Aug 2026); 6 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,387 psf (range $1,193–1,999); 2.3% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $39,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Bayshore MRT about 340 m, Siglap MRT about 750 m; closer than 58 of 94 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 3 within 2 km; nearest Temasek Primary School about 1,150 m; more than 0 of 94 similar developments (the same as 18). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 1 supermarket within 1 km (nearest about 170 m), more than 6 of 94 similar developments (the same as 15); nearest hawker centre East Coast Lagoon Food Village about 530 m; nearest park East Coast Park Area F about 150 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 1 other condo development sold new homes within 2 km (Vela Bay, 386 new sales, about 430 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 70 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 386 new sales and 479 resales (865 purchases); new sales were 44.6% of these purchases. Subsales (13) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Bedok Rise GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,970 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 479 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 48 of 94 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 479 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 489 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−2%). Planning-area private resales −7.9%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
